ability.animal_handling.name: Animal Handling
ability.animal_handling.description: Care and use of animals — raising, tending, grooming, and healing them.

ability.animal_ken.name: Animal Ken
ability.animal_ken.description: Communicate with animals as if they were people, treating your score as a shared language; lets you substitute Animal Handling for social Abilities with them.

ability.area_lore.name: {area} Lore
ability.area_lore.description: Knowledge of one particular region, covenant, or village — where things are, local history and legends, and the centers of power.

ability.art_of_memory.name: Art of Memory
ability.art_of_memory.description: Building memory palaces of loci to commit complex scenes, images, or writings to memory and recall them exactly.

ability.artes_liberales.name: Artes Liberales
ability.artes_liberales.description: The seven liberal arts of the Trivium and Quadrivium, the basis of medieval higher education; also covers reading and writing.

ability.athletics.name: Athletics
ability.athletics.description: General physical prowess — moving smoothly and with grace, and most large-muscle coordination.

ability.awareness.name: Awareness
ability.awareness.description: Noticing things, whether sought or unexpected, and staying alert when watchfulness is required.

ability.bargain.name: Bargain
ability.bargain.description: Getting the greatest return for a service or product while paying the least, by reading people and knowing the value of goods.

ability.brawl.name: Brawl
ability.brawl.description: Fighting hand-to-hand without weapons or with improvised ones; also used to dodge if you have no Martial Abilities.

ability.carouse.name: Carouse
ability.carouse.description: Enjoying yourself without ill effect — holding your drink and balancing merriment with acceptable behavior to win friends.

ability.charm.name: Charm
ability.charm.description: Enticing and endearing others on a personal basis, including winning someone over romantically.

ability.chirurgy.name: Chirurgy
ability.chirurgy.description: Medieval surgery — tending and binding wounds of all kinds and cauterization, to help others recover from physical damage.

ability.civil_and_canon_law.name: Civil and Canon Law
ability.civil_and_canon_law.description: Knowledge of Roman Civil Law and the Church's Canon Law, which together govern much of Mythic Europe.
specialties: laws and customs of a specific area

ability.code_of_hermes.name: Code of Hermes
ability.code_of_hermes.description: Judging events by the Code of Hermes and Peripheral Code, including the practical side of enforcing Hermetic law.

ability.common_law.name: Common Law
ability.common_law.description: Knowledge of the laws of England; it has no scholarly authority and is taught only in England.

ability.concentration.name: Concentration
ability.concentration.description: Focusing your mental faculties on one task for extended periods; especially important for magi maintaining spells amid distraction.

ability.corpse_magic.name: Corpse Magic
ability.corpse_magic.description: Temporarily revive a relatively intact corpse to speak to, compel, or animate it, provided it received no Divine burial rites.

ability.craft.name: Craft: {craft}
ability.craft.description: Handiwork of a given type, distinguished by the material worked; may be taken multiple times for different crafts.

ability.crafters_healing.name: Crafter's Healing
ability.crafters_healing.description: Heal a wound one level by spending a Long-Term Fatigue level; each wound may be treated only once and the recipient gains a Warping Point.

ability.curse_throwing.name: Curse-Throwing
ability.curse_throwing.description: Heal diseases and remove curses by transferring their effects to another person.

ability.dead_language.name: {language}
ability.dead_language.description: Fluency in a language no longer spoken natively where you have lived — Latin above all, the language of scholarship and the Church; available only to educated characters.

ability.dominion_lore.name: Dominion Lore
ability.dominion_lore.description: Knowledge of the manifestations of Divine power — miracles rather than doctrine or politics.

ability.dowsing.name: Dowsing
ability.dowsing.description: Find things nearby through a dowsing rod and your own intuitive sense.

ability.embitterment.name: Embitterment
ability.embitterment.description: Cause one person to hate another (detailed in the Hermetic Magic chapter).

ability.enchanting.name: Enchanting (Ability)
ability.enchanting.description: Influence others' emotions through a performance ability; general effects sway animals, but specific effects need words the audience understands.

ability.enigmatic_wisdom.name: Enigmatic Wisdom
ability.enigmatic_wisdom.description: The understanding House Criamon magi have of the Enigma; affects Twilight rolls and the deeper mysteries of magic.

ability.entrancement.name: Entrancement
ability.entrancement.description: Control another's will by staring into their eyes and giving a verbal command, resisted by the victim's Stamina with a bonus scaled to how dangerous the command is.

ability.etiquette.name: Etiquette
ability.etiquette.description: Knowing the social graces and how to behave properly in different situations — proper behavior rather than charm.

ability.faerie_lore.name: Faerie Lore
ability.faerie_lore.description: Familiarity with faerie powers, weaknesses, motivations, and areas.

ability.faerie_magic.name: Faerie Magic
ability.faerie_magic.description: The connection to the power of the Faerie realm possessed by House Merinita magi; cannot be learned by others.

ability.finesse.name: Finesse
ability.finesse.description: Manipulating your spells and performing special feats with them, such as positioning objects delicately or targeting spells.

ability.folk_ken.name: Folk Ken
ability.folk_ken.description: Understanding the background, personality, and motives of another person; the storyguide often rolls secretly.

ability.font_of_knowledge.name: Font of Knowledge
ability.font_of_knowledge.description: Attempt a task with any untrained Ability as if you had a score of 2, against an Ease Factor that rises with each use that day.

ability.great_weapon.name: Great Weapon
ability.great_weapon.description: Fighting with a weapon that requires two hands.

ability.guile.name: Guile
ability.guile.description: Telling convincing lies and feigning emotion or belief; also covers disguise and pretending to be what you are not.

ability.heartbeast.name: Heartbeast
ability.heartbeast.description: The ability shared by all House Bjornaer magi to take the form of their heartbeast; cannot be learned by others.

ability.hex.name: Hex
ability.hex.description: Bring injury or ruin upon enemies through eye contact, occult signs, or a sympathetic representation, setting a time frame that trades immediacy for power.

ability.hunt.name: Hunt
ability.hunt.description: Setting snares, choosing hunting spots, and following or identifying the spoor of creatures; also covering your own tracks.

ability.induction.name: Induction
ability.induction.description: Create illusions in a person's mind that only they perceive, growing harder as the risk the victim accepts increases; requires speaking with the victim.

ability.infernal_lore.name: Infernal Lore
ability.infernal_lore.description: Understanding and familiarity with the Infernal and its agents — demons, undead, and the power of curses.

ability.intrigue.name: Intrigue
ability.intrigue.description: Dealing and plotting — subtle, non-confrontational use of power, negotiation, and gathering useful information about those in power.

ability.islamic_law.name: Islamic Law
ability.islamic_law.description: The Muslim counterpart to Civil and Canon Law; its major sources are the Qur'an and the Sunna.
specialties: any one of the sources of Islamic Law

ability.judaic_lore.name: Judaic Lore
ability.judaic_lore.description: Knowledge of Jewish cultural practice — poetry, folklore, songs — as opposed to strictly religious detail.

ability.leadership.name: Leadership
ability.leadership.description: Getting people to obey and follow you, and inspiring fear to cow others into submission.

ability.legerdemain.name: Legerdemain
ability.legerdemain.description: Sleight of hand and confidence tricks — filching, cutting purses, and picking locks — opposed by the target's Awareness.

ability.living_language.name: {language}
ability.living_language.description: Fluency in a particular living language; your score measures how well you communicate, with the lower score governing a conversation.

ability.magic_lore.name: Magic Lore
ability.magic_lore.description: Knowledge of magical creatures, areas, and traditions.

ability.magic_sensitivity.name: Magic Sensitivity
ability.magic_sensitivity.description: Often able to identify a place or object as magical, but the sensitivity subtracts from your Magic Resistance.

ability.magic_theory.name: Magic Theory
ability.magic_theory.description: Knowledge of what magic is and how it works, used primarily in the laboratory; the technical details of Hermetic magic.

ability.medicine.name: Medicine
ability.medicine.description: The formal study of the body and its diseases, based on the theory of the four humors; treats poisons and starvation but not wounds.

ability.music.name: Music
ability.music.description: The ability to sing, play musical instruments, and compose new music.

ability.mystery_cult_lore.name: {mystery_cult} Lore
ability.mystery_cult_lore.description: The (Organization) Lore of a particular Mystery Cult — its legends, structure, rites, secret symbolism, and Initiation ceremonies.

ability.organization_lore.name: {organization} Lore
ability.organization_lore.description: Knowledge of the legends, history, structure, operation, and goals of a specified organization, from the Church to a local guild.

ability.parma_magica.name: Parma Magica
ability.parma_magica.description: A ritual that adds five times your score to your Magic Resistance until the next sunrise or sunset; known only to Hermetic magi and learnable only by the Gifted.

ability.penetration.name: Penetration
ability.penetration.description: Getting your spell through the target's Magic Resistance.

ability.persona.name: Persona
ability.persona.description: Alter your appearance to adopt a wholly different identity — even age or gender — without changing your essential nature; one identity per point in the Ability.

ability.philosophiae.name: Philosophiae
ability.philosophiae.description: The three philosophies — natural philosophy, moral philosophy, and metaphysics — all with Aristotle as their author.

ability.premonitions.name: Premonitions
ability.premonitions.description: Intuitively sense when something is wrong or about to go wrong, with a chance to grasp the nature of the danger.
specialties: threats to a particular person or group of people

ability.profession.name: Profession: {profession}
ability.profession.description: Doing a job that does not involve making something — jongleur, marshal, reeve, sailor, steward, and the like.

ability.rabbinic_law.name: Rabbinic Law
ability.rabbinic_law.description: The Jewish counterpart to Civil and Canon Law; its major sources are the Talmud, the Oral Torah, and the Responsa of the Geonim.
specialties: any one of the sources of Rabbinic Law

ability.ride.name: Ride
ability.ride.description: Riding and controlling a riding animal, especially under stress.

ability.second_sight.name: Second Sight
ability.second_sight.description: See through illusory concealment and disguise — including invisibility — and perceive naturally invisible things such as spirits and regio boundaries.

ability.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
ability.sense_holiness_and_unholiness.description: Feel the presence of good and evil in an area, person, or object.

ability.sense_passions.name: Sense Passions
ability.sense_passions.description: Sense an intelligent being's strongest emotion or dominant Personality Trait, and dimly tell holy from unholy; associated with the Infernal or a false power.

ability.shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
ability.shapeshifter.description: Change into a mundane animal between the size of a robin and a bear; you gain one available shape for each point in the Ability.

ability.single_weapon.name: Single Weapon
ability.single_weapon.description: Fighting with a one-handed weapon, possibly with a shield in the other hand; includes lances used from horseback.

ability.stealth.name: Stealth
ability.stealth.description: Sneaking about unseen and unheard, hiding, and following people without their noticing.

ability.summon_animals.name: Summon Animals
ability.summon_animals.description: You can summon animals (detailed in the Hermetic Magic chapter).

ability.survival.name: Survival
ability.survival.description: Finding food, water, shelter, a route, and relative safety in the wilderness, including making fire and cooking without implements.

ability.swim.name: Swim
ability.swim.description: Propelling yourself through water quickly and efficiently.

ability.teaching.name: Teaching
ability.teaching.description: The ability to teach an Ability to someone else.

ability.theology_christian.name: Theology: Christian
ability.theology_christian.description: The study of God and his work in the world, with the Bible and Peter Lombard's Sentences as authorities.

ability.theology_islam.name: Theology: Islam
ability.theology_islam.description: The Islamic equivalent of Theology: Christian; its major sources are the Qur'an and the Sunna.

ability.theology_judaism.name: Theology: Judaism
ability.theology_judaism.description: The Jewish equivalent of Theology: Christian; its major sources are the Torah, the Nevi'im, and the Ketuvim.

ability.thrown_weapon.name: Thrown Weapon
ability.thrown_weapon.description: Fighting at range using weapons that are thrown.

ability.whistle_up_the_wind.name: Whistle Up The Wind
ability.whistle_up_the_wind.description: You can create wind by whistling (detailed in the Hermetic Magic chapter).

ability.wilderness_sense.name: Wilderness Sense
ability.wilderness_sense.description: Mystically attuned to the wilderness — determine north, the coming weather, or nearby natural hazards and resources, one fact per roll.
